title: Use the current logo as the website favicon
user_quote: Use the logo for favicon too
scope: Exact existing mulberry-leaf/aqua-water logo as the favicon across all public reader routes. No artwork changes or public deployment.

implementation.before: 1,316 of 1,317 exported pages already referenced the current SVG, without a cache key or explicit type/size; search redirect lacked an icon.
implementation.after: Shared favicon_link helper returns the exact SVG with image/svg+xml, sizes=any and a source SHA-256 version. Search redirect uses the same helper. The approved symbol is byte-for-byte unchanged.
implementation.theme: Favicon standalone SVG follows system appearance; website manual theme remains independent.
implementation.preserved: Historical logos, cover artwork, poem/source content, compact header layout, runtime services, consent and release gates.

verification.browser: Linked SVG rendered with mulberry leaves and aqua water; local preview favicon tag matches the build. Existing icon artwork unchanged.

checklist.scope: Browser icon across all public routes; no page content/layout or reader controls changed.
checklist.not_applicable: No new poem, illustration, typography, interaction or service behavior. No new full page/accessibility audit needed for icon-link metadata.

reviewer: Current chat assistant; implementation and self-review
limitations: Linked icon file and page metadata verified in Chromium; cache behavior in other browsers and browser-chrome icon display not independently tested.
next_action: Current logo favicon is ready in the local preview and verified public build.
